description: This Java class defines a service 'CreateOrderFromCartFlow' responsible for orchestrating the checkout process, including cart validation, pricing, discounts, tax calculation, and order creation in a modernized Java-based e-commerce system. It integrates multiple external clients for cart, pricing, tax, promotions, and order services, and manages the checkout flow for a specific cart, returning the computed order details.

classes.name: CreateOrderFromCartFlow
classes.description: Main service class responsible for executing the checkout process by orchestrating calls to cart, pricing, promotions, tax, and order services, including validation, discount application, tax calculation, and order creation. Contains an inner record 'CheckoutResult' for returning checkout details.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main public method that performs the checkout orchestration given cart and customer identifiers, handling validation, totals calculation, discounting, tax, and order creation, returning a 'CheckoutResult'.

methods.name: validateCartMatchesRequest
methods.description: Validates that the cart's IDs and customer info match the request parameters, throwing validation exceptions if mismatched.

methods.name: mapCartToCreateOrder
methods.description: Maps a CartResponse object to a CreateOrderRequest used for order creation.

methods.name: calculateSubtotal
methods.description: Calculates subtotal by resolving prices for each cart item through the pricing service.

methods.name: resolveUnitPriceOrZero
methods.description: Resolves the unit price for a SKU, returning zero if missing.

methods.name: normalizeStoreCode
methods.description: Sanitizes store code input to a default value if null or blank.

methods.name: stableStoreIdLong
methods.description: Converts merchant store UUID to a positive long for store id in tax calculations.
